highlights.description: OmniMail Amazon SES v2 sender for transactional email

added.description: [omnimail] Amazon SES v2 sender implementing `omnimail.Sender`, delivering raw MIME built by `omnimail.BuildMIME` through `SendEmail`
[omnimail] SES message tags from `Message.Tags` and `Config.DefaultTags`, validated against SES tag rules
[omnimail] Configuration set, sending authorization identity ARN, and feedback forwarding address options
[omnimail] `Classify` maps SES error codes to omnimail error kinds with `Retry-After` support
[omnimail] Non-ASCII addresses rejected as `KindInvalidAddress` because SES does not support SMTPUTF8

fixed.description: [omnimemory] DynamoDB query `Limit` above `math.MaxInt32` no longer overflows the `int32` conversion; the page is capped at `math.MaxInt32-1`

dependencies.description: Add `github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sesv2` v1.78.0 for the OmniMail SES sender
Update aws-sdk-go-v2 modules to the v1.47.1 release set and `smithy-go` to v1.28.4, and other dependencies to their latest releases

documentation.description: [omnimail] SES sender guide with error mapping, IAM policy, and SES sandbox, DKIM, SPF and DMARC setup
Add OmniMail package links to README, docs index, and MkDocs navigation

tests.description: [omnimail] omnimail conformance suite against an httptest fake of the SES v2 SendEmail endpoint
[omnimail] Table-driven SES error classification tests and an opt-in mailbox simulator integration test

internal.description: Add the shared plexusone golangci-lint configuration so local runs match CI
[omnivault] Drop the unused context parameter from the convenience example

highlights.description: OmniDevX Kiro CLI collector for local developer telemetry
Historical token usage estimation from Kiro local SQLite and archived snapshots

added.description: [omnidevx] Kiro CLI collector implementing the `omnidevx-core.Collector` interface

[omnidevx] Optional `~/.kiro_sessions/*.json` archive snapshot collection
[omnidevx] Estimated `ai.usage.recorded` events for input, output, cache-read, and cache-creation tokens
[omnidevx] `ai.tool.completed` event extraction from Kiro request metadata and `ToolUse` records
[omnidevx] Defensive parsing for Kiro local format drift with diagnostics

documentation.description: [omnidevx] Kiro CLI collector documentation with usage example and OS-specific local paths
[omnidevx] Format-stability and historical-estimation caveats for Kiro local records

dependencies.description: Add `github.com/plexusone/omnidevx-core` v0.3.0 for canonical DevX events and local store compatibility
Add `modernc.org/sqlite` v1.54.0 for pure-Go Kiro local database access

highlights.description: OmniMemory DynamoDB provider for serverless memory storage

[omnimemory] Custom endpoint support for DynamoDB Local

documentation.description: [omnimemory] Comprehensive DynamoDB provider documentation with examples
[omnimemory] Configuration options, table schema, and IAM permissions guide
